newsitem.title: ESTONIA: GOVERNMENT SUPPORTS REGIONAL TAX EXEMPTION.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT SUPPORTS REGIONAL TAX EXEMPTION.

text.p: Estonian Prime Minister Mart Siimann said on Wednesday that the government has decided to exempt investments made in underdeveloped regions from corporate income tax.
"Corporate income tax will be exempted in regions were life is not improving and investments could help to create new jobs," he told a news conference.
Siimann added that the government has not decided on any specific region, but has discussed the north-eastern and south-eastern parts of Estonia and the islands as prime candidates for the exemption.
Those regions have the highest unemployment figures in Estonia and wages that are below the national average.
Siimann added that a draft law on the matter will be ready soon.
